content:
[project]
name = "mpm-nested-cv"
version = "1.0.0"
description = "Mineral Prospectivity Mapping with Nested Cross-Validation and Conformal Prediction"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
license = {text = "MIT"}
authors = [
    {name = "Seongin Ahn"}, {name = "Honggeun Jo"}, {name = "Jihoe Kwon"}, {name = "Gyesoon Park"}, {name = "Sang-ho Lee", email = "energy@kigam.re.kr"}
]
keywords = ["mineral prospectivity", "machine learning", "nested cross-validation", "conformal prediction", "uncertainty quantification"]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 4 - Beta",
    "Intended Audience :: Science/Research",
    "License :: OSI Approved :: MIT License",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: GIS",
]

dependencies = [
    "geopandas>=1.0.0",
    "matplotlib>=3.8.0",
    "numba>=0.58",
    "numpy>=2.0,<2.3",
    "optuna>=3.5.0",
    "pandas>=2.2.0",
    "pulearn>=0.0.9",
    "pyproj>=3.6.0",
    "pyyaml>=6.0",
    "scikit-gstat>=1.0.23",
    "scikit-learn>=1.4.0",
    "scipy>=1.12.0",
    "shap>=0.44",
    "shapely>=2.0.0",
    "xgboost>=2.0.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest>=7.4.0",
    "black>=23.0.0",
    "isort>=5.12.0",
]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/kigam-research/mpm-pu-conformal-yilgarn"
Repository = "https://github.com/kigam-research/mpm-pu-conformal-yilgarn"
Documentation = "https://github.com/kigam-research/mpm-pu-conformal-yilgarn#readme"

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["scripts"]
